title: Study Comparing Local/ MAC Anesthesia in Lumbar Decompression
official: Randomized Study Comparing Local/ MAC Anesthesia to General for 1-3 Level Lumbar Decompressions
summary: Explore efficacy, complications, and other factors associated with anaesthetic choice- To evaluate the efficacy of local + MAC as an alternative anesthetic to general anesthesia and to analyze patients' outcomes and experiences.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients with lumbar stenosis to be decompressed over 1-3 segments

* Ages 40-95
* Appropriate for general anesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Planned significant nerve root retraction
* Previous fusion operation
* Unable to comply with follow up
* Patients with daily morphine equivalents or more 100mg
* Patients with a known hypersensitivity to propofol or any of DIPRIVAN Injectable Emulsion components.
* Patients with allergies to eggs, egg products, soybeans or soy products.
